title: Sales by Month
flavorText: GROUP BY can group on any expression, including date parts. This unlocks time-series aggregation.
narrative: The transactions ledger has a month column. Aggregate sales totals by month to reveal trends.
schemaSql: CREATE TABLE sales (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, month TEXT NOT NULL, product TEXT NOT NULL, quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, amount REAL NOT NULL);
seedSql: INSERT INTO sales VALUES (1,'Jan','Datapad',3,899.97),(2,'Jan','Power Cell',10,199.90),(3,'Feb','Datapad',5,1499.95),(4,'Feb','Logic Board',2,179.98),(5,'Mar','Optic Lens',1,149.99),(6,'Mar','Servo Motor',4,220.00),(7,'Mar','Datapad',2,599.98),(8,'Apr','Power Cell',20,399.80),(9,'Apr','Logic Board',5,449.95),(10,'Apr','Steel Cable',50,425.00);
task: Calculate the total sales amount per month. Order by month alphabetically.

hints.text: GROUP BY month will create one group per distinct month value. Use SUM(amount) for the total.
SELECT month, SUM(amount) AS total_sales FROM sales GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;
SELECT month, SUM(amount) AS total_sales FROM sales GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;
